why: ESM requires the extension, so `import … from './mod.js'` is idiomatic. Stripping only `.ts`/`.tsx` minted `ts:lib/mod.js` with `external=False` — a first-party-looking module no file declares — and a CALLS target `ts:lib/mod.js.go`. Both the named and the namespace import must land on the real `ts:lib/mod`. The importer is `.mjs` on purpose.
